name: Google Cloud Storage
description: Typed Google Cloud Storage buckets, object metadata and generation-guarded bounded byte transfers.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Cloud Storage JSON API calls at storage.googleapis.com with encrypted OAuth access token; confirmed nodes create/change/delete buckets and objects. Custom tokenSecret names require host authorization. No filesystem discovery, automatic retries, refresh, background listeners or provider calls during build.

definitions.name: List Buckets
definitions.documentation: List Buckets: GET /b. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. definitions.name: Create Bucket
definitions.documentation: Create Bucket: POST /b. External mutation requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CREATE_BUCKET. Reconcile an uncertain outcome before rerunning. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. definitions.name: Patch Bucket Metadata
definitions.documentation: Patch Bucket Metadata: PATCH /b/{bucket}. External mutation requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_BUCKET. Reconcile an uncertain outcome before rerunning. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. definitions.name: List Objects
definitions.documentation: List Objects: GET /b/{bucket}/o. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. definitions.name: Patch Object Metadata
definitions.documentation: Patch Object Metadata: PATCH /b/{bucket}/o/{object}. External mutation requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_OBJECT. Reconcile an uncertain outcome before rerunning. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1 https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/buckets https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/insert https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/get https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/copy https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/rewrite https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/compose https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/authentication

definitions.name: Rewrite Object Step
definitions.documentation: Rewrite Object Step: POST /b/{sourceBucket}/o/{sourceObject}/rewriteTo/b/{destinationBucket}/o/{destinationObject}. External mutation requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation REWRITE_OBJECT. Reconcile an uncertain outcome before rerunning. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 30 s rewrite default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. definitions.name: Compose Object
definitions.documentation: Compose Object: POST /b/{bucket}/o/{object}/compose. External mutation requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation COMPOSE_OBJECT. Reconcile an uncertain outcome before rerunning. Use a pre-issued OAuth bearer access token in encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (or explicit tokenSecret); arrange issuance/refresh externally with Google IAM permissions and OAuth scope appropriate to the operation. No ADC, credential-file discovery, service-account signing, automatic refresh or connection profile assumptions. Fixed HTTPS storage.googleapis.com; redirects rejected. One request only, maxResults 1–100 for manual pages; rewriteToken is explicit continuation with unchanged source/destination/guard arguments. 10 s default / 30 s maximum request timeout; streamed response max 1 MiB, binary read/write max 256 KiB, request max 256 KiB; independent reader/body cleanup max 250 ms. $retries=0. Selected known fields only; metadata/labels are named string dictionaries. PUT replaces writable metadata, PATCH preserves omitted fields and permits documented null clearing. Generation strings retain integer precision; destination 0 means create only; existing object changes require a positive matching generation, bucket changes a positive matching metageneration. Upload is simple media; set richer metadata separately. Copy may fail for large objects: use explicit rewrite steps. Compose uses 1–32 pinned source generations and never deletes sources. No listeners, live provider validation or large/resumable transfers. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1 https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/buckets https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/insert https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/get https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/copy https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/rewrite https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objects/compose https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/authentication
